senses: to be right, be straight, be level, be upright, be just, be lawful, be smooth
to be pleasing, be agreeable, be right (fig.)
to make right, make smooth, make straight
to lead, direct, lead straight along
(Pual) to be made level, be laid smoothly out

strongs.def: to be straight or even; figuratively, to be (causatively, to make) right, pleasant, prosperous
strongs.kjv: direct, fit, seem good (meet), [phrase] please (will), be (esteem, go) right (on), bring (look, make, take the) straight (way), be upright(-ly)
